findings.what: In the JSONL loop, a List whose items are all strings arrives comma-joined, and a Class given as a bare enumeration member arrives unquoted. params_from_text parses both with serde_json::from_str and refuses parameter_invalid. As a result composition.precompose cannot be run from the drive loop with its declared type: layer_ids ["SLYR-a","SLYR-b"] becomes the text SLYR-a,SLYR-b and is refused. The same happens to queue_set_settings time_span "work_area_only" and resolution "full". The is_string() arm of the Class check is unreachable from the drive. The in-process tests pass JSON values directly, so no test catches this. Brief acceptance is the JSONL loop, and precompose is scenario step 38.
findings.fix: In params_from_text, when from_str fails: for List, split the text on ',' into a string array; for Class, use Value::String(text). Alternatively, have Live::motion take the raw JSON parameter values instead of the text map. Add one drive line for precompose to motion_commands_run_in_the_session_loop.

findings.what: The copy's document layer is built fresh: visible true, no appearance, default name. Composite reads dl.visible and dl.effective_appearance() (blend mode, opacity, fill opacity) for every composition layer (hsk-studio-composite/src/temporal/composition.rs:1003-1028). So the duplicate renders differently from its source when the source document layer is hidden, has a blend mode, or has a document opacity. A live boolean group is known to the vector records by its id, so its copy renders Content::None.
findings.scenario: composition.add_layer kind precomp -> layer.set_visible false on that layer (a driveable row) -> composition.duplicate_layer: the copy is visible. The same happens for an existing group or empty-raster layer that has an authored appearance.
findings.fix: Build the new StudioLayer from a clone of the source (new layer_id and name; keep visible, appearance and payload). Refuse layer_duplicate_unsupported when the source has vector-record or raster-record state keyed by its id.

findings.what: This path runs when an entry write fails after the layer was created. set_document_entry can refuse total_too_large (max_entry_bytes), which motion_entries_bytes does not pre-check, or canceled. The rollback has two faults. (a) run.current is set from last_command.take() AFTER the quiet undo, so the refusal record for composition.add_layer carries command_id history.undo and the undo's correlation; restructure_and_entry_step captures ctx before the undo. (b) restructure_inner cleared redo_stack on success, and the rollback clears it again, so a refused command destroys the redo history. That contradicts the module's claim that a refusal changes nothing; the existing *_and_entry steps use keeping_redo_without_new_step to avoid this.
findings.scenario: Composition records near max_entry_bytes, then composition.add_layer kind shape with a large root: refused total_too_large, the record's command_id is history.undo, and the redo stack is empty.
findings.fix: Capture let ctx = run.last_command.clone() right after restructure_inner returns, and use it for run.current before own_op. Wrap the created branch in run.keeping_redo_without_new_step(...), or save and restore redo_stack on failure.

findings.what: The declared value parameter of keyframe.add_at_current / toggle_at_current behaves inconsistently. If the property already has keys, value is silently ignored and the command reports ok with the interpolated value. If the property has no keys but a knowable static value (opacity 80), value overrides it and the render changes, which breaks the command's own STU-MOT-038 invariant.
findings.scenario: opacity static [80], no keys; keyframe.add_at_current time 0 value [50] -> key 50, render 80 -> 50. With keys present, value [50] is dropped with ok.
findings.fix: Honour value only when slot() had no knowable implied value, that is, when the hint created the member. Otherwise refuse parameter_invalid on value.

rulings_on_questions.two_ids: No collision. Every motion row id is <word>.<snake> with a prefix that has no underscore, so spec_id (dot to underscore, then uppercase) is injective. No other RUN_COMMANDS row is uppercase. row() matches the STUDIO_* form exactly and case-sensitively; lowercase studio_* is unknown_command. The spec (STU-MOT-130) names only the four namespaces, and each row's derived id sits in the right one. The canonical row id is what gets recorded.
rulings_on_questions.grouped_layer_creation: Undo/redo order is correct. Group = [structure, composition entry, motion entry]. Undo pops newest first (entries restored, then the layer deleted). Redo applies the structure first, then the entries. group_step rolls back a partial group (history_group_failed). Attribution is the restructure context (command_id = row id). The only defect is the create-then-entry-refusal rollback (F3).
rulings_on_questions.folio_validates_before_store: Every mutating path goes through motion_entries_bytes, which validates the composition always and the motion records whenever they are stored or created, against the document plus the created layers. validate_keyed refuses equal or descending key times, values with the wrong component count or not finite, out-of-range tangent count or influence, Bezier without a tangent, time > MAX_COMPOSITION_TICK, and more than MAX_STREAM_KEYFRAMES keys. NaN cannot arrive through JSON; a computed NaN or inf tangent from add_preserving (u rounding to 1.0 on huge segments) is refused as invalid_field, with no panic. Negative durations and negative times are refused by u64 decoding. Duplicate composition or layer ids, dangling precomp, render cycles and parent cycles are refused in Folio.
rulings_on_questions.expression_set_source: No wrong answer: the row takes layer_id, animator, selector and source, with no property key. A call addressed to a property refuses parameter_unknown, and a non-expression selector refuses selector_not_expression. Folio bounds the source to 1..=65536 bytes. Refusing instead is not needed for correctness.
rulings_on_questions.drive_test_change_at_tip: Not bug-masking. The shift by one (open line first, end line last) and exit 1 on refused lines match the existing protocol: a_stdin_session_... asserts r[0] is open and r.len() is lines + 2, and the hostile test asserts exit 1 on any refusal. NOTE: at d3ed4c4e the first assert (exit) panicked, so none of the later asserts (out[1..7], the reopen read) have ever executed. By trace they hold: the minted SCOM-...0001 target, invalid_field on width 1, undo reverting keyframe.set, and streams skipped when empty.
rulings_on_questions.attribution: Every record and step takes the Run's context. On success: begin(op) for entry steps, the restructure context for created layers, history group context from the newest inner step. No default actor. The one wrong attribution is F3(a).
